title: CI: validate runtime profile pack schema + golden snapshots (block invalid profile defs)
author: Sahana Iyer
description: Motivation: As we start landing more profile-pack changes (per-SKU defaults, scheduler knobs, KV cache headroom), we need a hard gate to prevent invalid/unsafe profile definitions from merging. We also need a stable way to detect unintentional drift in the shipped defaults (especially across release branches) while still allowing intentional updates with a reviewable diff. This PR adds (1) a required CI step that validates every profile definition against the schema + compatibility invariants, and (2) golden snapshot tests for the resolved defaults for our supported SKUs/workload buckets, so reviewers can see exactly what would ship. What’s included: - New CI job `validate-profile-pack` runs on every PR and is required for merge. - Schema validation for `runtime/profiles/**/*.yaml` using the same loader code path as runtime (no separate CI-only parsing). - Additional static invariants (guardrails) enforced in CI: required fields present, unknown fields rejected, headroom bounds, concurrency caps by SKU, and explicit `min_driver`/`min_cuda` when `sku == B200` (bring-up guardrail). - Golden snapshots: serialize resolved defaults for a small matrix (H100 SXM, H100 PCIe, L40S, B200 preview) into committed snapshots, and fail CI if resolved output changes without an intentional snapshot update. - Developer workflow: `./tools/profiles/update_golden_snapshots.sh` regenerates snapshots; CI prints a hint when snapshots are stale. - GitHub Actions wiring: add job to `.github/workflows/ci.yaml` and mark it required (branch protection handled separately by Release Eng; see Connor review note). Out of scope: changing any tuning values themselves (this is strictly validation + tests). Follow-ups: after runtime-1.22 cut we should add a separate perf-canary hook that compares resolved profile deltas to perf thresholds (ENG-4930), but this PR intentionally only blocks syntactic/semantic invalid configs.
commits: tools/profiles: add validate_profile_pack CLI entrypoint (load + schema + invariants)
runtime/profiles: add resolved-defaults serializer used for golden snapshots
ci: add validate-profile-pack job + artifacts on failure (resolved configs + error report)
tests: add golden snapshot runner + update script
docs: add CONTRIBUTING note for updating profile snapshots
conversation:
Connor O'Brien: This is exactly what we need before we make profile changes more frequent. Two nits: (1) make sure the job name matches what we plan to set as required in branch protection (no renames later), and (2) can we ensure the snapshots are deterministic across runners (timezone/ordering)?

Sahana Iyer (author): Good call. I renamed the job to `validate-profile-pack` consistently in the workflow + docs, and I’m sorting keys/arrays in the serializer. Also forcing UTC in the snapshot header and removing any timestamps (snapshots are pure resolved config JSON now).

Quentin Harris: On the invariants: can we make the B200 guardrail more strict? Specifically, fail if `sku == B200` and `min_driver`/`min_cuda` are missing, and also fail if someone tries to mark it as `default` selection without `preview: true`.

Sahana Iyer (author): Updated. Added: `B200` requires `preview: true` AND requires `compat.min_driver` + `compat.min_cuda`. Also added a check that B200 profiles cannot be selected unless `profile_version` is explicitly pinned (the check only applies in CI by asserting selection metadata, not runtime behavior).

Anika Gupta: Snapshot tests are great, but I want to ensure we fail on unknown fields. Otherwise typos silently do nothing.

Sahana Iyer (author): Yup — schema now uses `additionalProperties: false` across profile objects, and the loader errors on unknown keys. Added a unit test to make sure an unknown field fails validation.

Allison Grant: Can CI upload the resolved configs as artifacts when failing? That’ll help on-call/reviewers understand what changed.

Sahana Iyer (author): Added artifact upload on failure: `resolved-configs/` + `validation-report.txt`.

Noah Patel: Minor: ensure CI uses the same code path as runtime so we don’t end up with drift between CI and runtime selection/validation.

Sahana Iyer (author): CI runs `tools/profiles/validate_profile_pack.py` which imports the runtime loader module; it does not re-parse YAML separately. Added a small integration test that asserts loader version string matches.

Connor O'Brien: Approved once the job name and determinism changes land.

Connor O'Brien: Re-reviewed — LGTM. Please coordinate with Release Eng to add `validate-profile-pack` as required check on main and release/*.

Merge: Squashed and merged by Sahana Iyer. Post-merge note: Connor to update branch protection rules ahead of runtime-1.22 go/no-go.
release_notes: Internal: CI now blocks merges when profile pack definitions are invalid; resolved defaults are snapshot-tested to prevent unreviewed drift. Use ./tools/profiles/update_golden_snapshots.sh when intentionally changing shipped profile defaults.
